metadata.description: John Randall's public Claude Code plugins. Each plugin lives in its own repository.

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams that parse the first time: syntax reference, SVG/PNG/ASCII rendering, real product icons, and a hook that checks every .mermaid write.

plugins.name: mailing-labels
plugins.description: Shipping and return label PDFs onto peel-and-stick half-sheet sticker stock, and QR codes or images onto plain paper (macOS + CUPS).

plugins.name: macos-ocr
plugins.description: Text from images and scanned PDFs on macOS: vision-language model versus OCR engine, an Apple Vision helper, why embossed cards defeat bitonal scans, and extraction without exposing sensitive values.

plugins.name: ptouch-labels
plugins.description: Tape labels on Brother P-touch network printers (PT-P750W, PT-P950NW) through the ptouch-label CLI: tape probing, hi-res raster printing, half-cut strips, calibration, troubleshooting.

plugins.name: 3d-printing
plugins.description: FDM 3D-printing knowledge: filaments and drying, sourcing, storage and maintenance, recycling, models and tools, code CAD with build123d, publishing models. Bambu A1 notes included; no printer control.

plugins.name: obsidian-track-changes-agent
plugins.description: Lets AI agents take part in CriticMarkup review in Obsidian: agents propose and comment as tracked changes, and you accept or reject them with the Track Changes plugin.
